text: The 'subst' function in Cubical Agda / cubical TT (transport along a path) is definitionally:
choices: subst P refl x = x (transport along refl is the identity)
subst P p x ≡ x for all p
subst P p x requires univalence
explanation: A key computational property: transp (λ i → P i) i0 x computes to x when P is independent of i (i.e., the path is degenerate). This is the definitional β-rule for transport.
